SELECT 
  l.lesson_id,
  l.lesson_title,
  l.lesson_type,
  l.lesson_number,
  l.content_blocks,
  l.learning_objectives,
  l.success_criteria,
  l.estimated_minutes,
  l.difficulty_rating,
  l.mark_scheme_notes,
  l.exam_tips,
  l.common_mistakes,
  t.topic_name,
  t.topic_id,
  s.subject_name,
  s.subject_id,
  slp.status as progress_status,
  slp.completion_percentage,
  slp.confidence_rating,
  slp.time_spent_minutes,
  slp.notes as student_notes,
  slp.bookmarked,
  slp.last_accessed_at
FROM lessons l
JOIN topics t ON l.topic_id = t.topic_id
JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id = s.subject_id
LEFT JOIN student_lesson_progress slp ON l.lesson_id = slp.lesson_id AND slp.student_id = $1
WHERE l.lesson_id = $2 AND l.is_published = true

SELECT 
  l.lesson_id,
  l.lesson_title,
  l.lesson_type,
  l.lesson_number,
  l.estimated_minutes,
  l.difficulty_rating,
  slp.status as progress_status,
  slp.completion_percentage,
  slp.confidence_rating
FROM lessons l
LEFT JOIN student_lesson_progress slp ON l.lesson_id = slp.lesson_id AND slp.student_id = $1
WHERE l.topic_id = $2 AND l.is_published = true
ORDER BY l.lesson_number ASC

-- Update or insert lesson progress
INSERT INTO student_lesson_progress (
  student_id, 
  lesson_id, 
  status, 
  completion_percentage, 
  time_spent_minutes,
  confidence_rating,
  notes,
  started_at,
  completed_at,
  last_accessed_at
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
  COALESCE((SELECT started_at FROM student_lesson_progress WHERE student_id = $1 AND lesson_id = $2), NOW()),
  CASE WHEN $4 >= 100 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (student_id, lesson_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  status = CASE 
    WHEN $4 >= 100 THEN 'completed'
    WHEN $4 > 0 THEN 'in_progress'
    ELSE student_lesson_progress.status
  END,
  completion_percentage = $4,
  time_spent_minutes = student_lesson_progress.time_spent_minutes + $5,
  confidence_rating = COALESCE($6, student_lesson_progress.confidence_rating),
  notes = COALESCE($7, student_lesson_progress.notes),
  completed_at = CASE 
    WHEN $4 >= 100 AND student_lesson_progress.completed_at IS NULL THEN NOW()
    ELSE student_lesson_progress.completed_at
  END,
  last_accessed_at = NOW();

-- Update student stats
UPDATE students SET
  total_lessons_completed = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_lesson_progress 
    WHERE student_id = $1 AND status = 'completed'
  ),
  xp_points = xp_points + CASE WHEN $4 >= 100 THEN 20 ELSE 5 END,
  last_activity_date = CURRENT_DATE,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE student_id = $1;

-- Return updated progress
SELECT 
  slp.*,
  s.xp_points,
  s.current_level,
  s.total_lessons_completed
FROM student_lesson_progress slp
JOIN students s ON slp.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE slp.student_id = $1 AND slp.lesson_id = $2;

-- Log confidence rating
INSERT INTO confidence_logs (student_id, topic_id, confidence_rating, context, notes, logged_at)
SELECT $1, l.topic_id, $2, 'lesson_complete', $3, NOW()
FROM lessons l
WHERE l.lesson_id = $4;

-- Log learning event
INSERT INTO learning_events (student_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, metadata, timestamp)
VALUES ($1, 'lesson_completed', 'lesson', $4, 
  json_build_object(
    'completion_percentage', $5,
    'time_spent_minutes', $6,
    'confidence_rating', $2
  )::jsonb,
  NOW()
);
